source.included_scope: heat-pump tables 10-33 only; dual-fuel tables 34-57 excluded

policy.airflow: Largest CFM listed for each unit size and efficiency; fixed per model, never a runtime input.
policy.capacity: Gross total cooling before indoor fan heat; normalized at 95 F outdoor DB, 67 F entering WB, 80 F entering DB at selected airflow.
policy.missing: Manufacturer dashes retained as null; no extrapolation beyond valid catalog points convex hull.
policy.fitting: All valid source entries retained. Anchored ordinary least-squares capacity; bounded-output nonlinear least-squares SHR numerator.
policy.validation: Refit after holding out each interior outdoor-DB or entering-DB plane; capacity reference remains a known input. WB has only 3 levels; no independent WB-plane holdout test.
policy.scope: Cooling only. No electrical power/COP data are inferred. Unit-specific functions, not one universal heat-pump curve.
